meta.title: Materials
meta.description: An add-only multi-format materials library for DeepSeek Harness: pick Markdown, text/code, HTML, images, PDF, audio and video from your workspaces, preview any candidate in the picker before adding it, place icons on a fixed non-overlapping desktop grid, right-drag a marquee to select and move groups, put multi-selections into folders, and open anything full-screen with browser-style tabs and an immersive full-bleed reading mode. Each type has its own viewer: Markdown renders GFM tables plus Mermaid and chart blocks, HTML previews in a sandbox with same-folder assets, images zoom with Shift+wheel and open a full-screen layer on click (the whole screen in immersive mode, the panel otherwise), and PDF, audio and video play in place. The image page keeps only the file name, size and the actions it needs, while the other readers keep labelled path-bar actions.
